title: Perfect Ten
premise: A whale in a swim cap belly-flops off the high dive. The splash empties the pool onto the judges. All three hold up 10.
visual: Diving competition. A dripping judges' table. A pelican, a turtle and a goldfish in a bowl, completely soaked, holding up scorecards: 10, 10, 10. In the empty pool behind them, a whale in a flowered swim cap waves.
characterLean: Pairs with the walrus slide if you want a water-park episode cluster.

motion: 6-8s. Whale on the high board. Bounce, bounce. Belly flop. Wall of water. Cut to the soaked judges. Beat. Cards up: 10, 10, 10.
